ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a fourth-generation Echo Dot, so this older model adds little for me right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire Tablet with Alexa, 7" Display, 16 GB, Blue - with Special Offers (Previous Generation - 5th); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for a tablet, and this older model does not fill an obvious need.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle already covers this use.
ItemID: NA; Title: OontZ Angle 3 Bluetooth Speaker, Portable Wireless Bluetooth 5.0 Speaker, 10 Watts, Crystal Clear Stereo Sound, Rich Bass, IPX5 Water Resistant, Loud Portable Bluetooth Speaker (Black); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have an Amazon Tap and several Echo devices, with no current need for another speaker.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: An HD streaming stick would add little alongside my 4K Max.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already own a newer Fire TV device and do not need an older replacement.
ItemID: NA; Title: SABRENT 10 Port 60W USB 3.0 Hub with Individual Power Switches and LEDs Includes 60W 12V/5A Power Adapter (HB-BU10); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this to connect my USB peripherals and external drive; individual switches would be useful at my desk.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently bought a second-generation Show 5 and its stand, so this older version feels redundant.
ItemID: NA; Title: SanDisk Ultra 32GB microSDHC UHS-I Card with Adapter, Silver, Standard Packaging (SDSQUNC-032G-GN6MA); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Removable storage fits my past purchases and card reader, but I would wait until I need another card.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV with 4K Ultra HD and 1st Gen Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My 4K Max already handles streaming, so I would skip this older device.
